name: Clock probe: an item's 45 s equip proc cooldown expires by game time across long waits
contract: Val'anyr, Hammer of Ancient Kings (item 46017 in item_template) is a level-80 main-hand mace with Flags 0, so it
lacks ITEM_FLAG_NO_EQUIP_COOLDOWN, and its first item spell is 64415 with spelltrigger 1 (on equip). Priests
start with Maces (playercreateinfo_skills class mask 1107); the skill fixture keeps the equip independent of
that. Equipping casts 64415 from the item, and Player::ApplyEquipCooldown then sets that aura's proc cooldown to
now + the spell_proc Cooldown 45000 ms (db_world 2026_02_18_01) on the steady game clock. 64415 procs Blessing
of Ancient Kings 64411 on a positive heal (DBC ProcChance 100, spell_proc Chance 0, SpellTypeMask 2,
SpellPhaseMask 2), and an attempt during the cooldown neither procs nor extends it. Flash Heal 2061 rank 1 is a
1500 ms direct heal; the priest's health is lowered before each heal. Heals landing about 1.5 s and 39.5 s
after equipping stay inside the equip cooldown and do not proc; one landing about 47.5 s after equipping procs.
The 5.5 s and 2.5 s margins dwarf a 25 ms world step. The 10 s wait before equipping fast-forwards on the
simulated clock, so game time leads the wall clock by up to 10 s. An equip cooldown set from the wall clock
then ends early by that lead and lets the 39.5 s heal proc once the lead exceeds 5.5 s; proc checks that read
the wall clock lag the game-time cooldown and miss the 47.5 s proc once the lead exceeds 2.5 s.

steps.label: Fast-forward so game time leads the wall clock
SETUP: equipping applied the Val'anyr aura
Heal landing about 1.5 s after equipping
The equip cooldown suppresses the proc of a heal right after equipping
Long wait inside the 45 s equip cooldown
Heal landing about 39.5 s after equipping
DISCRIMINATING: a heal inside the equip cooldown does not proc
Wait past the end of the equip cooldown
Heal landing about 47.5 s after equipping
DISCRIMINATING: after the equip cooldown the next heal procs
